message: Hi Maya, Lakeshore Design here. Did the six Fog Line planters ship?
They went out by freight on Wednesday. Tracking is in your inbox.
Wonderful. The lobby install starts October 19.
They should arrive by October 9, with plenty of time.
Hi Maya! Is the studio sale still Saturday 9 to 3?
Yes, Saturday October 3, 9 to 3 at the studio. First 20 people get an ornament.
Do you take cards?
Cards, cash, and Venmo.
I can't make the sale until 1. Could you hold one of the wood-fired pots for me?
I can't hold sale pieces, sorry. It's first come at the door.
Totally fair. I'll try to come early then!
Missed the sale! Anything left over?
A few mugs and two Fog Line bowls. Leftovers go on the website Tuesday.
Perfect, I'll watch for them.
Is there room in the Thursday beginner class?
That session is full. I can add you to the waitlist for November.
Yes please. Is it the same price?
Same, $240 for six weeks, clay and firing included.
Great, sign me up for the waitlist.
First class was so much fun. My cylinder collapsed twice.
Everyone's does on night one. Next week we slow the wheel down.
Should I practice centering at home?
Just come ten minutes early and use the studio wheel.
Glad the kiln is fixed! What went wrong?
A burned-out relay. The new one arrived Monday and it fired fine on Tuesday.
Phew. Are the October orders still on time?
Yes, everything ships on schedule.
That copper red in test grid 38 is gorgeous. Reduction?
Yes, cone 10 reduction, heavy body reduction early on.
Would you ever sell that glaze recipe?
Not yet, I'm still testing it. Maybe a workshop next year.
Do you take commissions? I'd love a set of 8 dinner plates.
I do, for sets of six or more. Plates in a glaze from the shop run $58 each.
Fog Line, if possible. How long would it take?
About eight weeks, so mid December.
That works. How do I order?
I'll send an invoice for half up front. Send me your email.
For the care guide: can these go in the microwave?
Yes, everything but the gold luster pieces.
And the dishwasher?
Yes, but handwashing keeps the glaze glossy longer.
My mug arrived with a crack in the handle :(
I'm so sorry. Could you send a photo of the box and the mug?
Sent it by email just now.
Got it. I'll ship a replacement on Monday, no need to return the broken one.
Which glaze is on the bowl in your September 21 post?
That's Tide Pool over a white slip.
Is it food safe?
Yes, all my glazes are tested and food safe.
